sentences.text: The name Decuriasuchus translates to 'unit of ten crocodiles,' a reference to the ten known specimens discovered by scientists.
Every known example represents an immature individual measuring approximately 2.5 meters in length.
Marco Aurélio G. França, Jorge Ferigolo, and Max C. Langer first named this animal in 2011.
Based on growth rate comparisons, an adult Decuriasuchus may have reached a size of approximately 6 meters (20 feet).
Decuriasuchus quartacolonia is classified as the basalmost member of the clade Loricata, representing an early branch in crocodile evolution.
